unpublished_lock_order_failure.source_analysis: The initial observer held an immediate SQL transaction while invoking native current validation. unpublished_lock_order_failure.resolution: Native construction/validation occurs outside SQL transactions. SQL is re-read while native locks remain held, and the visitor sees a borrowed data view without a re-entrant validation method.
